findings.claim: Isolated PV cells are silent at I = 2.8 and I = 3.6 in every window (40 cells, native noise). 10 Hz is not bracketed in [2.8, 3.6]: PV_CALIBRATION_FAIL.
Rest-point instability (Euler map, dt 0.1): E 3.79669 (Hopf), PV 3.93623 (Hopf), SST 0.76311 (Hopf), VIP 22.5625 (saddle-node). Saddle-nodes: E 4.0, PV 4.0, SST 1.01562, VIP 22.5625.

At V_MID only E (5.0 > 3.797) and VIP (24.33 > 22.5625) have tonic above their rest-point instability. SST (0.59 < 0.763) fires 10.7-10.9 Hz in the network below its instability; PV (2.8) is below and silent. At V_HIGH, PV (3.6 < 3.936) fires 20.0-20.2 Hz in the network below its instability.

PV firing at V_HIGH and SST firing at V_MID are supplied by recurrent input (or by entry onto a limit cycle coexisting with the stable rest, as for E b near b_crit in V2.1c), not by tonic alone. Rate agreement with the battery_b1 F-I inversion at V_HIGH and V_MID was therefore coincidental for these classes; design F6 used it as support for weak recurrence and is withdrawn for PV and SST.

PV's rest point loses stability through a Hopf bifurcation at 3.936 with a saddle-node at 4.0, and battery_b1 records 0 Hz at I 2 and 25 Hz at I 4. An isolated tonic-only PV rate of 10 Hz is not established anywhere; whether a low-rate branch exists near onset is UNKNOWN from sealed evidence.
